description:
An easy-to-use Windows manager for personal game servers.

Synix Control Panel installs, configures, updates, monitors, and backs up personal game servers from one Windows application.
You can find the release notes on github in the closed pull requests. If you installed Synix v1.0.20 or earlier using `SynixSetup.exe`, uninstall that installed version first. Then download and run `SynixSetup.msi` like a normal Windows installer.
